newsitem.title: USA: Cerner approves stock repurchase plan.
newsitem.headline: Cerner approves stock repurchase plan.

text.p: Cerner Corp said Thursday its board of directors approved the repurchase of up to $25 million of the company's common stock.

Purchases are expected to be made in the open market or privately negotiated transactions. Cerner said the board and management believe the company's stock is significantly undervalued and expect the buy-back program will enhance equity value growth for long-term investors.

Cerner also said Neal Patterson, chairman and chief executive, and Clifford Illig, president and chief operating officer, have expressed an interest in purchasing in the open market a total of up to $2 million of additional Cerner stock. Patterson and Illig each own about 10 percent of the company's outstanding shares, Cerner said.
Cerner provides information systems for the healthcare industry.
